  Scenario: AC9 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key writes once
    Given the write for case "RC-2026-000512" has been made once
    When the same request is sent again with the same idempotency key
    Then the replay writes nothing and the listing holds one row

  Scenario: AC10 A consumed call does not answer inside 2 s and is retried
    Given rwb-case does not answer inside 2 s for case "RC-2026-000512"
    When the step runs

    Then nothing is written, no case move is answered and the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope

  Scenario: AC11 A consumed call fails with its breaker open
    Given the breaker of rwb-valuation is open for "AST-2026-000512"
    When the step runs

  Scenario: AC12 A status change the model does not allow is refused
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns the case state "ASSET_HELD" for "RC-2026-000512"
    When the step runs
